title: Alpine Macro王岩：全球收益率上行，风险资产如何应对？
speaker: Yang Wang

segments.en: I'm just wondering what the rising global yields, Yang Wang, how you feel about it, right? I thought, when we thought 5% was where this could derail risk assets in the light.
segments.zh: 我只是想知道，全球收益率上升，王岩，你怎么看？我认为，当我们认为5%可能是风险资产脱轨的水平时。

segments.en: We haven't quite seen that just yet. Do we need to subscribe a higher neutral rate on when the U.S. economy starts to slow down?
segments.zh: 我们还没有完全看到这一点。我们是否需要在美国经济开始放缓时，认为中性利率会更高？

segments.en: And what do you think is going to backstop that? Does it need a fed rate hike, for example, or do you think it's going to be a natural slowdown in this whole AI cap ex boom that's going to slow things down?
segments.zh: 你认为什么会支撑这一点？例如，是否需要美联储加息，或者你认为整个AI资本支出热潮的自然放缓会减缓事情？

segments.en: I guess it has to, you know, the market has to peak out. It has the least correct for the bond market to sell off.
segments.zh: 我想它必须，你知道，市场必须见顶。它至少需要债券市场抛售来修正。

segments.en: But now if the stock market just keeps doing, keeps rising, then, you know, it means that the financial conditions interest rates are not really overly restrictive yet.
segments.zh: 但现在如果市场继续上涨，那么你知道，这意味着金融条件和利率还没有真正过度限制。

segments.en: So then the bond yields will probably stay community to rise. You know, obviously, from from allocation point of view, now bond yields are at this level, obviously, it becomes a lot more attractive from allocation point of view.
segments.zh: 那么债券收益率可能会继续上升。你知道，显然，从配置的角度来看，现在债券收益率处于这个水平，显然从配置角度来看变得更有吸引力。

segments.en: But I guess it really, you know, stock market has to really feel the pressure from rising yield for yields to come off. All right.
segments.zh: 但我想，市场必须真正感受到收益率上升的压力，收益率才会回落。好的。
